products.title: AI-Control — Audit & Compliance
products.desc: A modular platform for planning, conducting and evaluating audits with AI assistance. For certification bodies, consultants and internal audits.
benefits: AI‑assisted audit planning (dates, teams, schedule) and generation of audit programs, checklists and reports.
Management of auditees, auditors and technical experts with AI‑generated internal profiles.
Mobile app (online/offline), photo/audio evidence, electronic signature and attendance export.
Corrective actions with due dates, ownership and notifications through verification and closure.
Modules: ISO 9001, 14001, 27001, 45001, internal audits; legal module; roles & licensing.
